gse244832.allowed_use: If complete license terms are resolved, external-development RNA-only topic mapping. Independent ATAC topic diagnostics may be reported, but no joint cell embedding is allowed across aliquots.
gse244832.model_access: Different aliquots are not shared cells. Held data cannot fit topics, topic count, learning rates, features, LSI, covariates, topic alignment, head, or calibration.

gse289173.allowed_use: If terms are resolved, one-time RNA-only topic prediction and cell-state mapping after selection lock.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA only through the frozen expression topic encoder; no paired or joint representation, fitting, feature selection, tuning, or calibration.

gse296875.allowed_use: If terms are resolved, outer-training RNA and ATAC topic models, paired joint-topic development diagnostics, and donor-held RNA-only mapping after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Exact same-nucleus joins only. Topic number, HVGs/peaks, LSI, covariates, models, paired topic diagnostics, head, and calibration use outer-training donors only.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen RNA topic proportions or prespecified ILR features plus identical benchmark head
local_model_roster.native_lane: paired concatenated RNA/ATAC ILR topics as development-only diagnostics

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; independent topic models only, never shared-cell joint representation
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact shared IDs permitted for outer-training joint diagnostics

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, topics, and peaks are not replicates.
rules.profile_rule: Within-modality imputation and paired topic concatenation are latent-only and cannot be scored as RNA-conditioned ATAC.
rules.query_isolation: Predict held RNA with frozen features, encoder, covariate transforms, and head; no held influence on any fitted choice.
rules.terms_gate: Do not execute, adapt, or redistribute MIRA until a complete BSD license text or written rights confirmation is frozen.
